## History

Christine Stuart was a music student who studied in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). While attending a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception, she was seen accompanied by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Rumors later circulated that she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) were engaged.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P15](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0015), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/christine-stuart--gilbert-blythe.md)

Christine Stuart and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are college friends who are frequently seen together around campus during their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Their public outings lead to widespread rumors among their peers that the two are engaged. This perceived closeness creates significant distress for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who becomes quietly upset and refuses to dance with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at their graduation ball after hearing of his attachment to Christine.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), +5 more_
